purpose: Summary of observed offline evaluator contracts before the first shot-study inference.
evidenceKind: Execution summary transcribed from tool outputs; not a retained omnibus test log.
fixturePolicy: Parser/gate fixtures and synthetic lavfi media were created in TemporaryDirectory directories, then deleted. No consumed or new study footage was used as a detector input.

checks.name: Temporal windows and marker parsing
checks.details: Five-second 24/12fps tail windows; boundary starts its new shot; unsupported subsecond shots; valid repeated requested indices; rounded scene score10 without marker does not create a cut; wrong exact integerPTS rejects.

checks.name: Independent window failures
checks.details: Four synthetic callbacks were attempted despite the first throwing and the third returning nonfinite output; results error,ok,error,ok; nonfinite values retained as string diagnostics and null numerical fields. No real detector was invoked.

checks.name: Native decoder and official preprocessing
checks.details: Synthetic lavfi master120frames and severe60frames both fully decoded with valid PTS/durations/SAR/pixel format, two windows and expected B1x16x3x224x224 tensors. No detector model loaded or called.

checks.name: Manifest and saved-gate evidence
checks.details: Complete synthetic45-row gate with build/source/canonical/frame-lineage receipts passed. Separate mutations rejected missing windows, positive scores in a negative gate, score/logit mismatch, false coverage, changed labels, misreported AI overlap, reordered cohort, false origin weights and self-consistent incorrect parent-frame construction evidence.

checks.name: Resource watcher subprocesses
checks.details: Synthetic memory and elapsed-time triggers each exited124 and retained a resource-failed receipt with unfinishedSelectedIds. No large memory allocation or model call.

checks.name: Self-reported recipe cannot substitute model
checks.details: A saved gate whose caller supplied its own consistent recipe fingerprint but changed modelSha256 was rejected before media/model loading.

checks.name: Final source readback
checks.details: Final Python AST/syntax, trailing-whitespace check,17 common source/vendor entries, exact builder identity and unchanged original evaluator verified after final evaluator/protocol edits.

scopeQualification: These were separate contracts executed across pre-freeze revisions, with final source-identity readback; they were not one retained omnibus run of every assertion against the final revision. Final expected-model binding and GCD control were separately tested after the broader gate fixture. A real successful45-video gate has not been observed.
claim: Software/receipt guards only. This does not establish detector accuracy or passage of any study stage.
